text_block_list.text:
I'm on my way to deliver some important
training
paperwork, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sigh... My stomach was grumbling all class. All that thinking is probably to blame.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Hehe. But that's normal for you, isn't it?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you think so? I don't know, I feel
like it's a
little louder today...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Want to come with me for
some
ramen?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the offer, I do. But, I can't
today...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Are you... feeling tired? You don't seem
like
yourself today...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Hehe, don't be silly. I'm always like this.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'm simply not in the mood for ramen
today, that's
all. Maybe another time!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Oh, th-that's fine. It's just—
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: I'm down for some ramen!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Hang on, El! What if Grass—
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Spe! Spe! Don't poke the hornet's nest.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: El? Did you say something?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Eek! Nope, not a thing! Come on, let's
get to
slurping!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! But we can't just leave her like
this.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: It's fine, it's fine! See you around, Grass!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Phew... I expected El to say something,
but even
Spe was on to me.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
How awfully perceptive of them, hehe. I
guess
they really are looking out for me.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
...I knew it. Merely increasing the length
of my
training sessions does nothing but
wear me out.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I need to improve my baseline
endurance and
consider what's
efficient...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
No more going easy on myself. I need to
get
stronger.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
The strict self-discipline and passion that
Grass
Wonder hides from those around
her are the fuel
that drives her to grow.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
